critical_code_review_comments: V2 algorithm uses weighted biomarker scoring (0-100) normalized against clinical reference norms by age/sex
Reference norms based on WHO, AHA, ACE (HRV: Shaffer & Ginsberg 2017, Body composition: Janssen 2000)
Temporal trends use first-half vs second-half average comparison for direction determination
Confidence levels: haute (>60 readings + >=6 biomarkers), moyenne (>20 + >=3), basse otherwise
Bio age calculation: composite_score 50 = exact age, each 10 points = ±2 years offset
Nora AI body_age blended 60/40 with algorithm when available (higher confidence override)
